title: Break The Pass
description: The main objective is to promote technology and innovation to improve lives, solve social challenges and enhance human capacity. Encourage education and knowledge sharing in technology-related areas to enable individuals and communities to acquire the skills and knowledge needed to succeed in the digital age. To foster collaboration and networking among practitioners, researchers, entrepreneurs and interested parties to exchange ideas, share resources and promote joint technological advancement.
